name: codebase-migrator
description: Unit-by-unit migration of a legacy Python codebase to a new target package behind a strangler seam, gated by a differential test against the legacy code itself: codex proposes inputs, the legacy code is executed to record the expected behaviour, codex ports and reviews each unit, and deterministic gates accept a port only when its observed behaviour, persistent-state effects and call route match. Experimental: Python to Python only.
